verdict.rationale: The DeepSeek changelog announces an experimental vision model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp) and later DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with native multimodal support. A community user confirms multimodal support is now available, which supersedes the earlier complaint that V4 was text-only. Missing for 10: a first-party guide showing how to send image inputs (formats, size limits), any evidence of audio or document/file input, and hands-on corroboration beyond changelog notices.
